New Chairman Appointed for Hindustan Shipyard Limited

Rear Admiral Chandrasekharan Raghuram (Retd.) assumed the role of Chairman and Managing Director of Hindustan Shipyard Limited (HSL) on July 2. HSL has been undergoing financial rebuilding and expanding its defense manufacturing capabilities. The appointment comes as the company focuses on its strategic role in Indian defense.
